descriptions.getenv: newlib getenv: calls _findenv_r (0x802eda34) with the global reentrancy structure, the name and a local offset.
descriptions.vfiprintf: newlib vfiprintf: calls the integer-only formatter at 0x802f1cf4 with the stream's reentrancy pointer, stream, format and argument list.
descriptions.w3d_stream_walk_all_802eb4e4: Appears to be SN's _cleanup_r: walks every open stream of the reentrancy structure with the routine at 0x802eb084.
descriptions.w3d_stream_flush_forward_802ec068: Forwards a stream to the stream routine at 0x802eb084 and returns its result.
descriptions.w3d_copy_bytes_802eb5f8: Copies count bytes from src to dst one byte at a time.
descriptions.w3d_libm_forward_802e83cc: Forwards a double to the math routine at 0x802e9850 and returns its result.
